title: Building evidence-based knowledge bases from full-text literature for disease-specific biomedical reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2603.28325v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Biomedical knowledge resources often either preserve evidence as unstructured text or compress it into flat triples that omit study design, provenance, and quantitative support. Here we present EvidenceNet, a disease-specific dataset of record-level evidence collections and corresponding graph representations derived from full-text biomedical literature. EvidenceNet uses a large language model (LLM)-assisted pipeline to extract experimentally grounded findings as structured evidence records, normalize biomedical entities, score evidence quality, and connect related records through typed semantic relations. We release EvidenceNet-HCC with 7,872 evidence records and a corresponding graph with 10,328 nodes and 49,756 edges, and EvidenceNet-CRC with 6,622 records and a corresponding graph with 8,795 nodes and 39,361 edges. translated_title: 从全文文献构建基于证据的知识库以支持疾病特异性生物医学推理
translated_abstract: 生物医学知识资源通常要么将证据保留为非结构化文本，要么将其压缩为省略了研究设计、来源信息和定量支持的扁平三元组。本文提出了EvidenceNet，这是一个疾病特异性的数据集，包含从全文生物医学文献中提取的记录级证据集合及相应的图表示。EvidenceNet采用大语言模型（LLM）辅助的流程，将基于实验的发现提取为结构化的证据记录，对生物医学实体进行规范化处理，评估证据质量，并通过类型化的语义关系将相关记录连接起来。我们发布了包含7,872条证据记录及对应图（10,328个节点、49,756条边）的EvidenceNet-HCC，以及包含6,622条记录及对应图（8,795个节点、39,361条边）的EvidenceNet-CRC。技术验证显示出很高的组件保真度，包括98.3%的字段级提取准确率和100.0%的层级（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究提出了EvidenceNet数据集，利用LLM辅助流程从全文文献中提取带证据质量评分的结构化证据记录并构建疾病特异性知识图谱，为肝细胞癌（HCC）和结直肠癌（CRC）等疾病的生物医学推理提供了保留研究设计与来源信息的证据级知识资源。
en_tdlr: This study presents EvidenceNet, a disease-specific dataset that uses an LLM-assisted pipeline to extract structured, quality-scored evidence records and graph representations from full-text biomedical literature, enabling evidence-based disease-specific biomedical reasoning.
